summary: One blocking finding is valid and should be repaired in spec.json by defining the owner and transaction boundary for post-command runtime and metric writes.

items.title: Post-command runtime/metric writes are not assigned an owner or commit boundary
items.rationale: The spec requires runtime/metric persistence and target worktree read-only cleanup, but it does not explicitly say what happens to dispatcher-owned runtimeLog metadata and agent metrics appended after the finalize-cleanup command returns.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements R1/R2 and overview.data_flow mention runtime/metrics persistence but do not define whether post-command dispatcher/agent writes are committed with final flow.json or stored in a durable sidecar.
